_comment: CommonJS output loads a deferred external lazily: `import defer` and `import.defer()` give a deferred namespace over `__toESMCached("ext-lazy", require("ext-lazy"))`. The chunk has no `require("ext-lazy")` at the top. `import.defer()` gets this form only with `dynamicImportInCjs: false` (see `external_cjs_dynamic_import`).
